stage: Implemented and engineering-checked locally; independent acceptance, owner policy adoption/publication, Google verification and actual OAuth/event acceptance remain separate.
customerJob: A signed-in owner understands Calendar data access, use, storage, sharing and retained-data controls before deliberately continuing to Google, and can find public same-domain details.
scope: Separate Calendar disclosure/privacy delta. Frozen billing sources and the Root uncommitted pure admin projections are unchanged. No provider request, Google permission, attestation, Console change, outreach, email, deployment or publication.
implementation: The existing Connect/Reconnect control opens the existing review dialog with a separate versioned Calendar disclosure. Continue to Google alone invokes the existing owner-bound start handler; Back and Escape do not submit. No redundant queue or consent framework was added.

Disclosure states actual granted scope and limited primary-calendar/own-visit use, Google/Netlify processing, sealed refresh token versus other records, absence of automatic record deletion, separate AI conversation facts, disconnect consequences and approved temporary Gmail deletion-help contact.

Same-domain privacy-policy.html#google-calendar documents exact visit fields, application token protection, retained records, Google permission removal and support request boundaries. General privacy contact now uses the already approved temporary Gmail address.

Disconnect review now distinguishes removing our refresh token and stopping new sync from retaining Google permission/events/workspace visits/history, including requests already sent. No deletion control or provider revoke behavior was added.

dataFlowReview.facts: Only implemented scopes events.owned and calendars.readonly; primary calendar identifier retained; refresh token sealed using AES-256-GCM with tenant/connection AAD; disconnect sets refresh=null and retains connection identity/history. OAuth state has logical expiry but is not a general retained-record deletion mechanism.

Sync jobs copy saved visit details and Google event references. They create/check/update/delete deterministic owned visit events and do not list unrelated events or call free/busy. No AI client import or model-dispatch path from Google responses.

Supported self-service bookings use portal-only saved records and scheduled Calendar delivery rather than legacy inline Google event results. AI receives separately supplied conversations and tool facts; this connection stores Google credentials in separate server-side connection rows rather than model messages.

Connection and sync values are Netlify Blobs JSON. Refresh-token sealing must not be described as encryption of every stored record. No automatic connection/sync record TTL or full deletion fulfillment procedure was established by inspection.

policyCommitmentsForOwnerReview: Use/transfer of Google API information according to Google API Services User Data Policy and Limited Use.
No sale, advertising use or general-purpose AI model training with Google API information; transfers only for the disclosed feature/security subject to Limited Use.

Human access limited to Google-permitted cases such as specific user agreement for support, security or legal obligations. Actual processor terms, staff-access controls and operational deletion fulfillment remain to be confirmed.

The public support text invites a reviewed, authority-verified request and explains limits. It does not claim automatic deletion, a demonstrated support receipt, verified deletion times, backup erasure, Google-event cleanup or a completed compliance audit.
